clauses.requirement: Reversing lamp (AR): failure provisions shall comply with paragraph 4.6 of UN R148.
Reversing lamp (AR): the colour of light emitted shall be white.
Rear fog lamps (F1, F2) are covered by the specific technical requirements of UN R148 paragraph 5.9; they apply only if the lamp incorporates a rear fog lamp function (not listed for this product).

Reversing projector (RP), luminous intensity and standard light distribution: outside the projection area defined by the individual specifications of UN Regulation No. 48, one of the following shall be fulfilled: (a) light emitted directly towards the rear shall not exceed 5·10^-1 cd within the angular field where the vertical minimum angle φmin = arctan((1-h)/10) degrees (h = mounting height in m) and the vertical maximum angle φmax = φmin + 11.3 degrees, measured over a horizontal angle from +90° to -90° relative to the line cutting the reference axis and perpendicular to the vertical transversal plane of the vehicle; or (b) where the apparent surfaces of the reversing projector and of the reversing lamp are arranged so that either their projections in the direction of the reference axis occupy not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing the projections, or the minimum distance between facing edges of the apparent surfaces, measured perpendicular to the reference axis, does not exceed 75 mm, the reversing projector shall be tested together with the reversing lamp and the integrated luminous intensity shall not exceed the maximum luminous intensity required in Table 10. Applies only if a reversing projector is fitted.
Reversing projector (RP): there is no requirement for minimum luminous intensity within the angles of geometric visibility.
Reversing projector (RP): there is no requirement for minimum or maximum area of apparent surface.
Reversing projector (RP), measurement: there is no additional requirement.
Reversing projector (RP): there are no additional specific requirements.
